name: Exp_RVIDiff
summary: This EA trades based on the RVIDiff custom indicator, which applies additional smoothing (T3 by default) to the Relative Vigor Index. It opens buy positions when the RVI value rises above its prior value during a downtrend in the RVI, and opens sell positions when the RVI falls below its prior value during an uptrend, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RVIDiff自定义指标进行交易，该指标对相对活力指数(RVI)进行了额外的平滑处理（默认T3）。当RVI在下降趋势中拐头向上时开多仓，在上升趋势中拐头向下时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于RVIDiff指标的动量反转信号。入场条件：当RVI值[1]小于[2]（即RVI下降趋势中），且当前值[0]大于等于[1]（即RVI拐头向上）时，触发买入信号；反之当RVI值[1]大于[2]且当前值[0]小于等于[1]时，触发卖出信号。出场条件包括固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），以及反向信号触发的平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持多种保证金模式（余额比例、净值比例、固定手数等）。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库提供的标准化仓位计算。策略在H6周期上运行，使用SignalBar=1即前一根K线的信号，避免未来数据偏差。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum reversal signals from the RVIDiff indicator, which smooths the standard RVI with an additional averaging method (T3 by default). Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when RVI[1] < RVI[2] (downtrend) and RVI[0] >= RVI[1] (momentum turning upward); a sell signal is triggered when RVI[1] > RVI[2] (uptrend) and RVI[0] <= RVI[1] (momentum turning downward). Exit conditions include a fixed 1000-point stop-loss, 2000-point take-profit, and closing positions on opposing signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter with multiple margin modes including balance-based, free margin-based, and fixed lot sizing. Money management leverages the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for standardized position calculation. The strategy operates on H6 timeframe by default, using SignalBar=1 to reference the previous bar's values, avoiding look-ahead bias.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 保证金模式：自由保证金/余额/亏损自由保证金/亏损余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/drawdown free margin/drawdown balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许反向信号平多仓
parameters.description_en: Allow buy position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许反向信号平空仓
parameters.description_en: Allow sell position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description: 平滑相位参数（JJMA范围-100~+100，VIDYA/AMA使用不同含义）
parameters.description_en: Smoothing phase (-100~+100 for JJMA, different for VIDYA/AMA)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号计算使用的K线索引（1=前一根已收盘K线）

pros: 使用SignalBar=1避免未来数据偏差，回测结果更可靠
提供多种平滑算法选择，策略灵活性高
包含完整的止损止盈机制和滑点控制
买卖开关可独立控制开仓和平仓，策略配置灵活
使用标准化的TradeAlgorithms库处理仓位计算，代码复用性好
pros_en: Uses SignalBar=1 to avoid look-ahead bias, making backtesting results more reliable
Offers multiple smoothing algorithms (10 methods), providing high strategy flexibility
Includes complete stop-loss, take-profit mechanism and slippage control
Buy/sell open and close switches are independently configurable, offering granular control
Leverages standardized TradeAlgorithms library for position sizing, ensuring good code reuse
cons: 缺少点差过滤，在点差较大时可能产生不必要的亏损入场
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
止损1000点和止盈2000点固定值，未考虑市场波动率自适应调整
依赖iCustom调用外部指标RVIDiff，如果指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
没有时间过滤或交易时段控制，可能在流动性差的时段交易
cons_en: Lacks spread filtering, which may cause unnecessary losing entries during high-spread periods
No position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Fixed 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP do not adapt to market volatility changes
Depends on iCustom calling external RVIDiff indicator; EA fails if the indicator file is missing
No time filter or trading session control, may trade during low-liquidity periods
improvements: 添加点差过滤器，当点差超过阈值时暂停交易以避免不利入场
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致过度杠杆
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整止损止盈距离
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to pause trading when spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding unfavorable entries
Add position check logic to prevent duplicate same-direction entries that increase leverage exposure
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that automatically adjusts to market volatility

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，高波动时段点差扩大可能导致不利入场
没有持仓检查，可能重复开仓导致风险敞口超出预期
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率，低波动时止损过大，高波动时止盈不足
risk_points_en: No spread filter; widened spreads during high-volatility periods may cause unfavorable entries
No position check; duplicate entries may cause risk exposure to exceed expectations
Fixed SL/TP does not account for market volatility; SL too wide in low volatility, TP insufficient in high volatility
